scope: Twelve existing source pages and fourteen exposed development queries. Source filtering and reading-window expansion are evaluated separately; no Agent or physics success claim.

source_filter.mechanism: Classify actual source DOM nodes: keygroup ownership marks metadata; an abstract-local list containing only same-page section links marks navigation, including its adjacent colon label; pure-text paragraphs between equations or an equation and variable-definition list remain equation context. No blacklist of where/and or length-based blanket deletion.
confirmed_examples: This page discusses and its table of contents
TypeHistory data and LevelStep in keygroup
where between an equation and variable list
source_filter.effect: Seventeen source blocks no longer generate standalone search records; their original bodies and source provenance remain stored. All fourteen selected Top-4 parent-ID lists equal the previous flat-list pilot, so no retrieval-answer improvement is attributed to filtering in this batch.
source_filter.limits: This is a structure-specific rule validated on the selected documentation and fixtures, not an exhaustive classifier for every page template. Formula context is retained, not given a supported formula-search implementation.

reading_windows.policy: Merge at most four adjacent searchable ordinary p/text blocks, with an approximately 3000-character expansion bound. Require the same document, release, source hash, anchor and complete heading path. Definitions/lists/code/formulas or excluded roles break runs. An oversized original atom is not cut by grouping; the existing final body budget still applies.
reading_windows.selection_control: Take the same ranked Top-4 parents first, then map them to reading windows and deduplicate. Do not backfill extra low-ranked windows after merging.
reading_windows.provenance: Window records retain ordered member parent IDs and source block XPaths. This requires the complete source-ordered parent registry returned by the persisted store; it is not a generic grouping operation over an arbitrary subset or shuffled mapping.

content_review.finding: With exactly the same selected parents, the first window now contains zero out-of-plane normal/shear strain, planar assumptions and the separate thermal-expansion/thickness-stress statement. The latter was absent from plain parent delivery. Existing generalized-plane-strain distractors remain in other windows.

The Riks method paragraph is accompanied by its immediate motivation; the material window retains the time/strain-rate limitation. The unstable-response window also adds alternative dynamic/stabilization approaches and a figure caption. More context is not uniformly necessary context.

The almost-incompressible window combines numerical sensitivity with independent pressure interpolation. The fully incompressible window retains the plane-stress and material-behavior qualifications already present in neighboring source paragraphs.
The complete exact-time paragraph and the full kinematic/distributing contrast list remain delivered. Lists remain atomic, so the window does not pretend to reinterpret their internal structure.
The necessary explanation is not among the selected parents. Windowing parameter definitions does not promote the separate explanatory paragraph; ranking remains a separate unresolved layer.
The declared permanence/BC magnitude evidence is still absent from the selected or retrieved context. Window expansion is not a substitute for missing candidates or proper evidence selection.

assessment: The two implementation goals have bounded evidence: structural non-content is isolated without destroying originals, and reading windows repair one confirmed cross-paragraph incompleteness without modifying ranks. The window roughly increases typical delivered text volume and can expand existing distractors. This supports continued controlled evaluation, not unconditional adoption or a claim that RAG is finished.
